        visited[i][0] = True
        visited[i][m-1] = True
        q.append((i, 0))
        q.append((i, m-1))
    
    for j in range(m):
        visited[0][j] = True
        visited[n-1][j] = True
        q.append((0, j))
        q.append((n-1, j))
    
    # BFS - traverse through all non-wall cells
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        
        # This cell is already marked visited at start, proceed to neighbors
        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < m:
                if grid[nr][nc] != wall and not visited[nr][nc]:
                    visited[nr][nc] = True
                    q.append((nr, nc))
    
    # Fill all unvisited non-wall cells with 4
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            if grid[i][j] != wall and not visited[i][j]:
                result[i][j] = 4
    
    return result
